name: DeepSeek API 余额
runs_on: dsh Desktop app (Electron; same dsh-base + dsh-web-app composition)

slots.name: conversation.input.right
slots.position: composer input-bar trailing zone — right of the textarea, before the model selector and send button

state.purpose: Returns the official account balance (total_balance) plus the snapshot timestamp. The browser half polls it; the API key is resolved on the host and never appears in a response.

baseURL.description: DeepSeek API base URL. The balance endpoint is <baseURL>/user/balance.

apiKeyEnv.description: Credential reference name to resolve (via ctx.credentials, then the environment, then ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml).

dependencyPolicy.note: The host half imports only node: builtins — no @deepseek-ai/* at all — so it cannot be broken by a profile whose node_modules resolves a different dsh runtime version than the one executing it. Config validation is hand-written (carrying the Standard Schema ~standard interface Cordis calls) rather than schema-package-driven, for the same reason.

dataProvided.balance: Official GET /user/balance result: balance_infos[0].total_balance shown on the chip, in the account's reported currency.
dataProvided.breakdown: balance_infos[0].topped_up_balance (充值) then .granted_balance (赠金), rendered as indented sub-rows under the total on hover — the user's own funds lead, the platform's gift follows. An absent field hides its row rather than showing 0.
dataProvided.updatedAt: Timestamp of the last successful snapshot, shown as 更新时间.

persistence: None. The plugin is stateless: no token tracking, no baseline, no storage file.

behavior.hover: Glass tooltip showing 账户余额 with its 充值 / 赠金 breakdown as indented sub-rows, plus 更新时间 and the auto-refresh state.
behavior.autoRefresh: Optional 5-minute polling toggle, default OFF, remembered per browser in localStorage.
behavior.animations: None. Pure CSS with --dsw-* design tokens; no transitions, keyframes, or timer-driven repaints.
behavior.currency: The balance renders in the account currency the official API reports (CNY for CN accounts).

install.note: This package IS a bundle (it declares dsh.bundle), which is what makes it appear on the profile's 插件 page with its own toggle. The page manages BUNDLES only; a package without dsh.bundle never shows up there no matter how it is installed.

requires.note: engines.dsh is deliberately '*' so ANY dsh runtime can install this package. dsh gates installation and loading separately: install always succeeds, but outside the tested 0.2.x line the loader skips this bundle — the 插件 page still shows the card, the composer shows no widget, and GET /deepseek-balance/state returns 404, with a 'skipping profile bundle ... incompatible' warning on stderr. That is a version mismatch, not a broken install.

bundle.mounts: itself — the patch row's name equals this package name
bundle.containing:
- insert:
    - id: deepseek-balance
      name: dsh-deepseek-balance
      config: {}

install.optionOrder: --profile must follow `plugin` directly. `plugin add --profile web ...` fails with "required option '--profile <name>' not specified". Use forward slashes in link: paths.
install.autoSelection: Because the package declares dsh.bundle, `dsh plugin add` appends its name to `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically — no hand-editing of the profile manifest.
install.patchYaml: Leave the profile's cordis.patch.yml as `[]`. The deepseek-balance row comes from this package's own bundle patch; inserting it here as well would register the plugin twice. Toggles from the plugin page write id-targeted overrides into this file, which is correct.
